contradicting_evidence: Weak current participation, negative settled flows and shrinking stablecoin supply could extend the downside beyond the 72h window.
Positive hourly spot buying and declining OI leave room for stabilization or a rebound, opposing a confident week-long bearish extrapolation.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Rebound attempts and downside retests remain plausible, but the supplied evidence does not establish which will dominate the full week. A BTC-led recovery would not establish broad market recovery without persistent improvement in ETH/BTC and alt participation.
falsification_conditions: Persistent price recovery accompanied by stronger ETH/BTC, broad participation and improving settled flows would establish an upside edge.
Persistent price deterioration accompanied by weak participation, continued outflows and further liquidity contraction would establish a downside edge.
A single rebound, one improved breadth reading or one flow session would not resolve the weekly uncertainty.
missing_evidence: Multi-session price, breadth, relative-strength and flow persistence.
Evidence that stablecoin liquidity stabilizes and is deployed into risk assets.
Updated macro developments and a usable catalyst schedule for the forecast window.
supporting_evidence: Current negative participation and liquidity conditions establish vulnerability but do not determine a full week's net return.
The reconciled 90d altseason score is 49, whereas the 30d score is 29; these describe different windows rather than a confirmed forward rotation.
A flat hourly ETH/BTC reading and limited price stabilization establish neither sustained relative recovery nor continued deterioration.
There is insufficient independent temporal evidence to extend the 72h downside bias confidently across 168h.
